# Vendored front-end libraries

| File | Library | Version | License | Why |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| jsQR.js | [jsQR](https://github.com/cozmo/jsQR) | 1.4.0 | Apache-2.0 | Reads QR codes from the camera on the staff Scan page when the browser has no built-in `BarcodeDetector`. Kept inside the project so scanning works without internet. |
| fonts/instrument-sans-latin-wght-normal.woff2 | [Instrument Sans](https://fonts.google.com/specimen/Instrument+Sans) (variable weight) via @fontsource | 5.x | OFL-1.1 | v2.0.0 interface: body text and headings. Kept inside the project so pages look the same offline. |
| fonts/instrument-serif-latin-400-*.woff2 | [Instrument Serif](https://fonts.google.com/specimen/Instrument+Serif) via @fontsource | 5.x | OFL-1.1 | v2.0.0 interface: the italic accent words ("Found something?", "reconnect."). |
| fonts/jetbrains-mono-latin-*.woff2 | [JetBrains Mono](https://www.jetbrains.com/lp/mono/) via @fontsource | 5.x | OFL-1.1 | v2.0.0 interface: small uppercase labels, codes and references. |
